Operating reconciliation 13, cash-flow statement 34, net-debt reconciliation 5 and shared theory 8 correspond on paper 6–7 and scheme 10–12. Examples of cash and non-cash profit are open responses, not a finite choice pool.
All five error scenarios are required in the 40-mark journals, followed by profit correction 12 and shared trial-balance theory 8. Paper 8 and scheme 13–14 correspond.

All property ledgers over the required five years share 48, balance-sheet extract 4 and depreciation theory 8, matching paper 9 and scheme 15–18. The repairs ledger prints 2018 where the paper specifies 2019. Choosing a depreciation method is business-context theory, not an optional exam route.
Five calculations at 10 each, bank report 40 and shared gross-profit calculation/explanation/improvement 10 correspond on paper 10–11 and scheme 19–22. All report factors are required.

Profit statement 40, trading/profit-and-loss 50 and choose-two concept theory 10 correspond on paper 12–13 and scheme 23–27. The Irish paper expressly bounds four basic concepts; the scheme identifies going concern, accruals, consistency and prudence. All six two-concept combinations correspond to the English expansion. Scheme 25 prints loan interest due 160,000 instead of 160, and the loan working refers to two repayments although the paper first specifies January 2022; the original figures remain available.

Accumulated fund 30, income/expenditure 35, balance sheet 25 and shared special-purpose/subscription theory 10 correspond on paper 14–15 and scheme 28–32. Scheme 31 prints opening fund 956,750 while scheme 28 gives 596,750; the final total is consistent with 596,750. No alternative task results.

All four departments are required for apportionment 33 and reapportionment 8, both production-department rates at 3, job 310 price 23 and shared theory 10. Paper 16–17 and scheme 33–35 correspond; all tables are upright.

Both Golden and Portland products are required in production 18, purchases 16, manufacturing 16, unit cost 11, trading 9 and shared theory 10. Paper 18 and scheme 36–39 correspond. Scheme 40 is annotations, 41 Irish bonus, 42–43 blank and 44 cover.
